topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Flowers without a card, huh? Figured it wouldn't be this straightforward. Someone's trying to lay down a trail, maybe testing the waters to see what kind of ripples it makes. I've seen it a hundred times before. People leave things unsaid, thinking it's clever, mysterious. Ain't nothing but a smokescreen, usually. But I can play along. I scoped the place, nosed around a bit. I've got my theories, but I'm not jumping to conclusions. Not yet. I'll need a bit more to go on. But if there's one thing I'm good at, it’s piecing together the puzzle when the pieces don’t seem to fit.
